$schema: Feature-claim manifest (protocol §2A). CI gate: scripts/check-feature-claims.mjs. A claim may only be status=verified when its evidence files exist and (for test evidence) the referenced test currently passes in CI. Claims affecting money movement, auth, or secrets may never be marked verified without test evidence.

claims.claim: Wallet transfer is atomic: guarded debit (balance >= amount) and credit commit in one DB transaction with distinct per-leg references
claims.limitations: PG-backed concurrency soak pending in CI

claims.claim: Retryable financial mutations are idempotent via claim-then-execute (INSERT ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING + 102 placeholder + payload-hash binding)
Stripe top-ups credit wallets only on webhook-signature-verified events, idempotent per stripe event id
Payouts enforce maker-checker (approver != initiator) with FOR UPDATE fund reservation
No production path returns fabricated data: simulation only behind PAYGATE_SIMULATION_MODE=true with simulation:true labeled payloads
Authorization is deny-by-default (pbacProcedure permission map, fail-closed) and cookie mutations pass CSRF origin guard
claims.limitations: Live cross-tenant negative tests pending staging env

claims.claim: All Python microservices require INTERNAL_API_KEY with constant-time comparison and fail closed when unset
claims.limitations: Verified by code sweep (113 files reference key, compare_digest in all auth paths); live negative tests pending

claims.claim: Database schema is migration-managed end to end: 83 migrations apply cleanly to a fresh PostgreSQL (308 tables)
claims.limitations: Verified against embedded PG 17 in assurance sandbox; CI migrate-check job recommended

claims.claim: Nightly security audit job runs real posture checks and persists snapshots; dashboard reads only real snapshots
claims.limitations: Cron schedule (02:00 UTC) must be registered in the heartbeat scheduler at deploy time

claims.claim: InfraPage detail views (Kafka topic history, consumer group detail, Redis node history) serve real kafkajs-admin/ioredis observations
claims.limitations: Kafka admin path not exercised against a live broker in sandbox
